items.evidence: play seed 1 with notes/winning_inputs_6.txt, --at 6000..7400 step 10: after wave 5 (score 450) wave 6 spawns 15 entries of kind runner, health 1 at Normal, x drops 0.5 per 10 ticks (3/s), each 90 ticks after the last (6110, 6200, ...); no walkers in wave 6.

Texts read 'Wave 1 of 6'..'Wave 6 of 6', 'Oleada 1 de 6', 'Vague 1 sur 6'. At tick 6000 wave 5 is cleared (450, screen play, not won). Won only after wave 6: 615 (11 runners killed, 4 through, gate 1) and the engine's find gave a win at 660 (14 killed, gate 4). 15 per runner: 450+15*15 = 675 for a full clear.

Right on Language goes en -> es -> fr (stops at fr), Left goes back fr -> es -> en. With fr: title 'Tenez la porte/Jouer/Réglages/Quitter', settings 'Réglages/Volume : 8/Langue : Français/Difficulté : Normal/Retour', play 'Score : 0/Vague 1 sur 6/Porte : 5', paused 'En pause/Reprendre/Titre', won 'Vous avez gagné/Score : 615/Entrée : titre', lost 'Vous avez perdu/Score : 0/Entrée : titre'. Frames of all of them look right ('Score' and 'Volume' are also French words).

The settings texts are [Settings, Volume, Language, Difficulty: Normal, Back] (frame shows Difficulty between Language and Back). On it, Right: Normal -> Hard; Left: Hard -> Normal, Normal -> Easy. Fresh default normal. Shown 'Dificultad: Difícil' in es and 'Difficulté : Difficile' in fr.

Seen: Easy walkers 1 and runners 1 (wave 6 reached on Easy), Normal walkers 2 and runners 1, Hard walkers 3. Not seen: Hard runners 2. No Hard run reached wave 6 (the winning script loses in wave 3 on Hard, and the engine's find gave up after 300 s). The code (lib.rs: base+1 on hard) says 2, but that is not something I saw the game do.

Checks file with a shared settings folder: one run sets hard/fr/volume 6, and the next run starts with hard/fr/6 and walker health 3. A hand-made pre-change settings.json {volume 3, language es}, with no difficulty, loads as es/3/normal, with walkers at health 2.
The state has "difficulty":"normal" and walkers have "kind":"walker"/"runner"; --frame --size 800x480 writes a PNG of 800 x 480 (checked with file).

Re-ran m01-m19: title state JSON; 800x480 frame; title texts, Down+Enter opens Settings, Start gives wave 1/score 0/gate 5; volume stops at 10 and 0; Spanish settings/title/play; settings kept and fresh defaults; guard 6/s with clamp to 0..12; bolt every 24 ticks at 14/s; wave 1 has 5 walkers at 1.5/s, 90 ticks apart, in lanes 2-10; hits take 1, a kill is +10, other lanes are untouched; gate -1 per walker and lost shows the score; wave 2 starts 180 ticks after it clears, 'Wave 2 of 6'; 450 after five waves; Enter on won goes to the title; pause freezes, Resume and Title work; the same seed gives the same md5 and seed 7 gives other lanes; the play frame matches the state; title and settings frames mark the focused entry; strings tables and README add-a-language; README commands work as written.
CHANGES.md lists each change with its files (lib.rs, fr.json, game.json, settings.json, strings), what was checked and how, with the win command, and what was found wrong before.

defects: README 'How to play' still says 'Walkers have 2 health' and the Settings section says only volume and language are kept; it does not mention difficulty.
CHANGES.md says Easy/Hard runs were only checked at the first spawns, and Hard was never played to wave 6.
The Language setting does not wrap: Right on Français and Left on English do nothing. It is still the English-Spanish-French order.
could_not_check: c05: no Hard run reached wave 6, so the Hard runner health of 2 was never seen (the engine's find failed in 300 s; no --set exists to start at wave 6).
